rows.design: controlled, within-patient: two lesions treated, two lesions on another side as control; randomization and blinding not in abstract; no laser-only or tacrolimus-only arm
rows.skin_tone: not in abstract (authors' affiliations are in Bangkok, Thailand; study site not stated)
rows.lesions_enrolled: 120 lesions 'treated' (abstract wording); whether this count includes the control lesions is not in abstract
rows.citation: Chitvanich S, Rerknimitr P, Panchaprateep R, Pongprutthipan M, Asawanonda P. J Dermatolog Treat 2016 Oct;27(5):456-60
rows.intervention: fractional 1550-nm ytterbium/erbium fiber laser, four sessions every four weeks, plus 0.1% tacrolimus ointment twice daily
rows.comparator: control lesions on another side (treatment of control lesions not in abstract)
rows.endpoint_definition: relative lightness index (reference skin for the index not in abstract), treated vs control
rows.time_from_last_treatment: NOT_DERIVABLE: assessed at week 12 'after three sessions of laser treatment', [i.e. mid-course: before the fourth of four laser sessions, with twice-daily tacrolimus presumably still in use]; the abstract does not state the week of each session or when the final assessment was made
rows.arm_result: relative lightness index normalized; difference vs control statistically significant at week 12 (p = 0.026); arm values not in abstract
rows.texture_or_scar: not in abstract for this time point (swelling and redness were the most common side effects and resolved spontaneously)
rows.uncertainty: 'A total of 120 lesions were treated' conflicts with the design of two treated plus two control lesions per patient: either 120 treated lesions ([60] patients, [240] lesions in all) or 120 lesions in all with [60] treated ([30] patients); the abstract does not say which, and gives no patient count, so clustering of lesions within patients cannot be assessed. Combination only: with no laser-only or tacrolimus-only arm, the abstract cannot separate the effect of the laser from that of tacrolimus. Whether control lesions received tacrolimus or any vehicle is not in abstract. [From the ledger's rerknimitr2015 record, not from this source:] same five authors, same 1550-nm ytterbium/erbium fiber laser, same four-sessions-every-four-weeks schedule and same two-treated, two-control lesion layout as rerknimitr2015 (PMID 25303024); the abstract does not say whether patients overlap, so a shared cohort cannot be ruled out. This is a mid-treatment reading, not a result after the final treatment. The abstract says 'statistical significant compared with the control' but gives no lightness values for either arm and does not say whether significance held at later visits. Instrument lightness does not establish a colour match a person would see.
